e9::seg-desembolso.text02: Every condition is rechecked before Pix.
e9::seg-desembolso.text03: Before each Pix transfer, the system rechecks collateral, settlement controls, the accepted agreement, and amounts, down to the cent. Payment proceeds once every condition is confirmed, with any items requiring review clearly explained to the desk. A unique transaction ID connects the app, transaction list, and payment.
e9::seg-desembolso.text12: PIX RELEASED UPON FULL VALIDATION · REVIEW DETAILS FOR THE DESK · UNIQUE TRANSACTION ID
e9::seg-desembolso.notes: Presentation paths: 20 · 40 · 60. The system gives the bank confidence in the conditions in place when funds are released. Before each Pix transfer, it rechecks collateral, settlement controls, the accepted agreement, and amounts down to the cent. Each transfer document and each note secures a single transaction. Payment proceeds once every condition is confirmed; any items requiring review come with a clear explanation for the desk to manage the case. A unique transaction ID provides a shared reference across the in-app experience, team monitoring, and payment.
e9::seg-aprovacao.text02: Approval stays within authority and matches the offer.
e9::seg-aprovacao.text07: Above the assigned approval limit, measured by face value, one person approves and a second authorized person confirms. The system ensures that each role is performed by a different person.
e9::seg-aprovacao.text08: The initial approval remains valid for 30 days for the exact amount, term, rate, agreement, and document reviewed. Any change or the end of that period requires renewed approval.
e9::seg-aprovacao.text09: The system enforces limits per application, customer, and payer at every designated stage. Cases routed to a person for review proceed with that person's decision.
e9::seg-aprovacao.notes: Presentation paths: 20 · 40 · 60. The system preserves the institution's control over who can confirm an approval and for what amount. It measures approval authority by face value and applies the institution's ceiling. Above the assigned limit, two distinct people are required; by default, confirmation is reserved for the institution's designated lead and people they authorize. The initial approval is tied to the reviewed offer and requires renewal after a change or 30 days. Limits apply during simulation, offer, acceptance, and desk review. Cases assigned for human review retain their human decision requirement. Applications on hold trigger an alert, and the desk can close them.
e9::seg-capacidade.text03: Every asset secures lending within its value.
e9::seg-capacidade.text04: The system reserves the lending capacity of pledged assets, keeping total commitments within each asset's value. The initial confirmation of that capacity requires two people. Each transfer document and each note is linked exclusively to a single transaction.
e9::seg-capacidade.text07: Capacity reserved within the asset's value
e9::seg-capacidade.text12: Review details visible to the desk
e9::seg-capacidade.notes: Presentation paths: 40 · 60. The system gives the bank a clear view of committed collateral capacity when reviewing a new transaction. For assets such as livestock, vehicles, and real estate, it reserves lending capacity and keeps total commitments within the asset's value. The initial confirmation of that capacity requires two people, sharing responsibility for the valuation used. Transfer documents and notes are each linked exclusively to one transaction. These controls distinguish an asset's available value from a document's exclusive transaction link, preserving the institution's control over the collateral in use.
e9::seg-instalacao.text03: Installation proceeds once every required component is in place. Until then, the system keeps the environment intact and explains the requirement. Institutions using the dashboard in place of the credit desk receive reviews in the dashboard queue. Every production installation includes before-and-after records, an audit trail, and duplicate protection.
e9::seg-instalacao.text05: Required components verified before installation, with clear guidance and the environment preserved.
e9::seg-instalacao.text07: Institutions using the dashboard in place of the credit desk receive reviews in its queue.
e9::seg-instalacao.text09: Before-and-after records, with an audit trail and duplicate protection.
e9::seg-instalacao.notes: Presentation paths: 40 · 60. The system preserves operational continuity during installation and gives the institution a clear record of changes. A package is installed once its dependencies are in place; until then, the environment stays intact and the system explains which requirements must be met. The credit channel, for example, requires the credit desk component for installation. Institutions using the dashboard in place of the credit desk retain review routing through the dashboard queue. Every production installation retains before-and-after records, an audit trail, and duplicate protection.
e9::seg-mudancas.text02: Every change earns its place in production.
e9::seg-mudancas.text03: Every change goes through a validation environment before production and a second person's review. Automated tests using a real database validate each change, including concurrent applications drawing on the same collateral or limit. Release requires passing results for the exact version being incorporated and a fresh validation if another deployment occurs during the checks.
e9::seg-mudancas.text08: REAL DATABASE · CONCURRENT USE OF THE SAME COLLATERAL · EXACT CHANGE VERSION
e9::seg-mudancas.notes: Presentation paths: 40 · 60. The system safeguards the bank's confidence as the platform evolves. Every change goes through a validation environment before production and is independently reviewed by someone other than its author. Automated tests using a real database require passing results before a change can proceed. Checks cover applying data changes to an empty database, alignment between data and system rules, credit workflows, and concurrent applications drawing on the same collateral or limit. Release requires results for the exact change version. Another deployment during the checks triggers a fresh validation before release.
e9::seg-rede-dados.text03: The system restricts external calls to permitted destinations, keeping the internal network and infrastructure configuration information protected.
e9::seg-rede-dados.text04: The system maintains exclusive write access to reservations, acceptances, signatures, and audit trails, authenticating the source of each record.
e9::seg-rede-dados.text05: Customers can receive an emailed data report with masked information, delete their biometric data, and re-enroll their face. Notifications follow their preferences, include delivery records, and are sent once per event per channel.
e9::seg-rede-dados.text06: CONTROLLED DESTINATIONS · SERVER-MANAGED WRITES · CUSTOMER PRIVACY
e9::seg-rede-dados.notes: Presentation paths: 40 · 60. The system controls external call destinations and authenticates the source of transaction records. External calls follow destination controls that protect the internal network and infrastructure configuration information. The system maintains exclusive write access to reservations, acceptances, signatures, and audit trails, with authenticated origins. Customers can receive an emailed report of their data with masked information, delete their biometric data, and re-enroll their face. Communication follows customer preferences: each notification is sent once per event per channel, with an audit trail for every delivery.
e9::abertura.notes: Presentation paths: 20 · 40 · 60. Sequences: 20 · executive · 24 slides; 40 · product · 73 slides; 60 · technical · 94 slides. Follow the tag in each note. Open with the relationship the institution builds with its customer. The offering combines clear terms, contracting channels, and operations that support the loan throughout its term. Catalisa delivers this under the buyer's brand, with Decision as the shared engine across credit products. To explain what the buyer is purchasing, describe a platform for configuring, distributing, and operating financial products, from customer engagement to portfolio management. Lead with the white-label proposition, available on-premises or as SaaS, with commercial responsibilities defined in the partnership.
